title: IsoScreen: data, code and web tool for "Resolution limits of predicted selectivities in isomer separation"
description: Dataset of 68,763 infinite-dilution activity coefficients and 31,541 isomer pairs, out-of-fold predictions of all models, trained models, and code for data curation, model training, the figures and the IsoScreen web tool (https://muyingjie71-oss.github.io/isoscreen/).
